Needs changes before merge.

The source review found no additional code defect. The required heavy tests have no result for this head.

- Both regression tests pass without changes to their assertions.
- The fallback keeps the existing area and crossing checks. It limits the tangent change to `1e-3`.
- The decision record explains the two fixes and the held ring-order change. `Refs #2849` correctly keeps that issue open.

Safety mutations rerun locally:

1. Restore only `lead_ext.rs` from upstream main. `an_axis_aligned_lead_start_posts_the_users_arc_entry_as_g18_or_g19` fails at `crates/app/tests/lead_approach.rs:133`, with `true vertical arcs now:`. The notes report oblique chords.

Each mutation failed at the expected assertion. After restoration of both PR files, all 7 `lead_approach` tests passed again. No source changes remain.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/motion/src/machining2d/descent_xy.rs:97` and the PR body, `Not exercised`: run the reached heavy lanes on the final head. Add their results to the PR body. The current [AGENTS.md, Heavy lanes at review](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/blob/6e1805bfdae52fcfea71a946d381dfbfdefc79f5/AGENTS.md#L628-L636) requires these tests before readiness. `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` selects both motion and app heavy lanes. The body says that the release tiers did not run. Run `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`. Keep its known-fail checks. This review ran the plan only; the full heavy lanes remain untested. The quick gate and the extra debug suites do not meet this requirement.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: the missing heavy gate results on the final head.

`cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` is green: 238 steps, 0 failed. Motion heavy tests: 59 passed. App heavy tests: 43 passed. All four known-fail checks stayed enabled and failed as expected: three for #1950 and one for #2849.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` is green: 6 steps, 0 failed. The `lead_approach` regression tests passed. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

The PR body now records these results. The review requested test results only. No source change or new commit was needed. The final head remains `635c0c7bc8c187a92cfcd589aedca9a1597b0efd`.

Please re-review this head.

Second safety read (Opus, read-only): clean

Scope: a read of the diff and of the changed files at `635c0c7bc8c187a92cfcd589aedca9a1597b0efd`. This read did not build and did not run tests. The PR was already merged (2026-11-22T04:10:06Z) when this read started. This comment is a record after the merge.

**The earlier change request of mkinney (02:20Z)**
- The one finding was "the heavy lanes have no result on the final head". It was not a code defect.
- The author ran `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` on the same head and recorded the result in the body and in the 03:58Z comment. The head did not change.
- The finding does not apply after that record. The clean marker at 04:07Z is consistent. Its heavy-lane result is the author's run, not a reviewer run. The re-review says so.

**Axis start reseat (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/lead_ext.rs:36-75`)**
- The new start is the midpoint of an edge of the same ring (`(a + b) / 2`). It is on the ring polyline, so it cannot move off the wall into material.
- The vertex order does not change. Thus the cut direction (climb or conventional) and the wall side do not change.
- The change only removes the "first edge within the tolerance keeps the start" exit. The reseat to a different edge was already possible before. The later lead-room `reseat` in `contour_start::seat` (`contour_start.rs:371-373`) still proves the lead at the new start.
- `i == 0` returns `None`. All indices are `i < n` or `% n`. A zero-length edge is skipped (`l > 0.0`). There is no panic.

**XY arc entry on the closing edge (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/descent_xy.rs:84-144`)**
- The first-cut tangent is tried first, as before. The closing-edge tangent is a second try only. Every path that fit before fits the same way.
- The second tangent is accepted only with `dot > 0` and a sine of at most `1e-3`. Thus the arc arrives at `e` with a direction change of at most about 0.06 degrees from the first cut. The arc direction cannot reverse.
- `arc_at` does not change. Its proof does not depend on the tangent source: the inscribed fan and the circumscribed hull are both proved with `chord_ok` against the certified area and with `chord_hits_plan` against the planned passes. The arc stays between them. Thus it cannot cut the wall. The arc is at the cut plane, so it cannot cut the floor.
- The plane stays G17. The side stays consistent: `ccw` puts the centre to the left of the tangent (G3), and `!ccw` to the right (G2).
- Degenerate input: `closing_dir` returns `None` for a pass that does not return to its start, or that has fewer than 4 points. A closing vertex nearer than `DIR_MIN_LEN` is skipped. A zero vector gives `None` through `unit`. A collinear closing edge equal to the first-cut tangent is removed by the filter. When no try fits, the existing `Err` gives the named fallback note. There is no unwrap, expect or panic outside `#[cfg(test)]`.

**Known-fail markers (#2567)**
- #2849 is OPEN. The body uses `Refs #2849`. There is no closing keyword.
- `lead_approach.rs`: both `#[ignore = "known-fail #2849 | ..."]` lines and both `// known-fail-assert` lines are removed. The asserts do not change. No `#[ignore]` stays in the file.
- `shoulder_adaptive.rs:285` keeps its exact known-fail marker. Line 313 keeps `// known-fail-assert` immediately before the expected failing assert.
- No pin is deleted. No plain `#[ignore]` is added.

**Posted goldens**
- None changed. The diff has four files only: two motion sources, one app test and one decision record.

**Notes (not blockers)**
- If the nearest-axis edge is not exact (for example 0.3 degrees off), the reseat goes to that edge and the arc is still posted as chords. That output is correct. It is the same class as before.
- The new arc tangent can be up to 1e-3 rad off the first cut. This gives a small kink at `e`, inside the proved area. It is not a gouge.

Blockers: none.
